title: meta read: a view stored with no `label` is served with `label` = its qualified name (`recheck_gate.default`), invented by the read-side translator, so the console view tab shows the machine name
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible defect with a named landing and a live reproduction. A machine name is shown where the platform's own code says no label was authored.

QA-source: #23942 · studio-authoring · observation (cloud slice comment on #23878; re-checked and filed under #23878)

## What happens

The spec declares `label` optional on a view (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:5154`, `I18nLabelSchema.optional()`), with no default. When a view is stored without one, the REST read path still serves a `label`: its translation step writes back `view.label ?? view.name`, so the document carries `label: "OBJ.default"`. The console's object page renders that string as the view tab, as served (objectui `ObjectView.tsx` `viewTabLabel`), so the user sees `recheck_gate.default`. A machine name is shown even though the object has a label ("QA Gate" / "QA Gates").

The REST layer already knows this fallback is not a label. For view-container slots it drops it explicitly (`meta-item-read-gate.ts:3005-3008`: "A `label` that equals `input.name` where `input` had none is the translator's fallback, not a translation, and is dropped"). The single-item read and the list read keep it. A consumer therefore cannot tell an authored label from an invented one without comparing it to `name`, which is the tolerant-consumer shape PD #12 forbids.

## Reach — measured, 2/2 fresh loads

Environment: objectstack `7277c07f` (main, 2026-10-16), `examples/app-showcase` booted from a main worktree, `OS_PORT=47321 objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 47321 -d file:…/data.db`. Console: objectui `daeb77fc` (the `.objectui-sha` pin), built against `@objectstack/spec` from `a35f7a67^` (`34b740f2`), because the pin does not build on main (#23885 / #23908). `check:console-sha` matches. Playwright with `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, form sign-in as the seeded admin.

1. `POST /api/v1/packages` `{"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.recheck","name":"QA Recheck","version":"1.0.0","type":"app","namespace":"recheck"},"enableOnInstall":true}` → 201.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/recheck_gate?package=com.qa.recheck`: label "QA Gate", pluralLabel "QA Gates", fields `name` and `kind` → 200.
3. `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/recheck_gate.default?package=com.qa.recheck` `{"name":"recheck_gate.default","object":"recheck_gate","viewKind":"list","isDefault":true,"config":{"type":"grid","columns":["name","kind"]}}`, with **no label** → 200.
4. `GET /api/v1/meta/view/recheck_gate.default/layers`: `overlay` and `effective` carry **no** `label`.
5. `GET /api/v1/meta/view/recheck_gate.default`: `item.label: "recheck_gate.default"`. It is appended as the last key, after `_diagnostics`.
6. Browser: `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/recheck_gate` shows the header "QA Gates", and the only view tab reads **`recheck_gate.default`**. Same on two fresh loads.

The same fill reaches stock form views. `GET /api/v1/meta/view` lists `showcase_task.form`, `showcase_task.tabbed`, `showcase_contact.create` and others with `label` equal to their name.

- **Expected:** a view with no authored label is served with no `label` (or `null`), as the container slots already are. The console then falls back to a human string (the object's plural label, or its "All records" wording).
- **Actual:** the served document asserts a label nobody wrote, and it is the machine name.

## Where

- objectstack main `7277c07f`:
  - `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:481` is `const fallback = view.label ?? view.name;` in `resolveViewLabel`.
  - `:1186`: `translateView` writes it back unconditionally (`return { ...view, label, … }`).
  - `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:2881`: the single-item read runs it through `translateMetadataDocument`. `:2823` does the same for the list read.
  - `:3023` (`if (key === 'label' && input.label == null && value === input.name) continue;`) drops it for container slots only.
  - The resolver's own pin, `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts:294-303`, pins the resolver's return value, not the served document.
- objectui main `023087f63` is the consumer half: `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:956`, `const text = view.label || view.name || view.id;`. Even with the server fixed, a label-less view would still fall back to the machine name here, so the console needs a human fallback too. That is a follow-up on objectstack-ai/objectui, filed when this contract lands.

## Done when

- The single-item and list meta reads serve a view with no authored label without an invented `label`, the same way the container path does. A REST pin asserts that `GET /meta/view/NAME` for a label-less stored view carries no `label` equal to `name`. Translated labels still resolve.
- A consumer card on objectstack-ai/objectui is opened for `viewTabLabel`'s fallback (human string, never the qualified name).

**Reader who acts:** the REST/i18n read-path owner (`domain:services` or `domain:spec` execution seat; triage picks). The diff is in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` `translateView` / `resolveViewLabel` or in the REST read gate's view translation.

## Dedupe

- MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, all states: "served view label falls back to view name translateView resolveViewLabel tab shows object.default" → 11 hits, all read. #4854 (view labels never resolve a translation, closed), #21006 and #22614 (closed) are neighbours. None covers the invented label.
- objectstack-ai/objectui#12693 (machine names in Studio: Explain chips, Columns chips) does not carry the view tab, so this is not folded there.

Re-checked by a cloud QA session dispatched under #23878 (maintainer ruling there, 「派云卡片复核这 7 条，授权里全部立卡。有时间间隔就行」).
